summary: Wrapper that forwards a float80 (extended-precision) operand: passes the 64-bit view of the ST0 value to FloatExponentExtractWithNaNGuard, then returns the result of the adjacent helper sub_58858D, whose outputs are produced through the __usercall register/stack convention. The legacy ABI label identifies the chain as a float80-to-double conversion with a two-step call pattern.

local_names.a1: low 64 bits of the float80 operand (ST0)
local_names.v2: stack slot populated via the register/stack calling convention by the callee chain
local_names.v3: stack slot populated via the register/stack calling convention by the callee chain

operations.description: Call FloatExponentExtractWithNaNGuard(a1, HIDWORD(a1)) on the 64-bit representation of the operand to extract the exponent and guard against NaN.
Call sub_58858D(v2, v3) passing the two stack slots left by the prior call's register/stack side effects.

unresolved: v2 and v3 are uninitialized in the decompiled view; they are populated by FloatExponentExtractWithNaNGuard through the __usercall register/stack convention that Hex-Rays cannot track as an explicit output.
The actual float80-to-double conversion steps live in sub_58858D and 0x0058DD28, outside this function body.
